author: Nintendo of America
description:
Play Cult of the Lamb – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition now: https://ninten.do/6007axddZ
 
Start your own cult in a land of false prophets! Venture out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland Followers, and spread your Word to become the one true cult. 
 
The Nintendo Switch 2 version of Cult of the Lamb includes enhanced resolution, improved frame rates, and GameShare support. The upgrade will be available for free to owners of the original Switch version of Cult of the Lamb.

author: Nintendo of America
description:
Play Orbitals exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2: https://ninten.do/6009aanHv
 
Check what the critics are saying about Orbitals! 

Team up with a friend as Maki and Omura in this intergalactic adventure. The future of the settlement rests on both of your shoulders! 
Built from the ground up for asymmetric 2-player co-op, you’ll have to use teamwork and clear communication to overcome danger and navigate uncharted areas. Will you be able to save their home together? 
With the goal to honor the warmth and style of classic Japanese anime, the Orbitals universe is brought to life with hand-crafted cinematic cutscenes from Studio Massket, full Japanese and English voice acting, and an original soundtrack that channels the magic of the era.
